annotations.title: Get a songwriter by person ID

description: Use when you have a Songlinks person ID (SLP-XXXX-XXXX-X), from find_songwriter or a person page, and the user wants that writer's details: the registrations grouped into the person, records listed apart as possibly the same person, and their first works. Each record says how it was joined: `main` marks the record the ID was issued on, and `rule` is the evidence: same_ipi (another of the person's records carries the same IPI name number), ipi (it carries the person's own number), model (judged the same writer from works, co-writers and publishers in common; `score` is how sure), corroborated (confirmed by an independent source) or verdict (decided by a person). At most 25 works are listed; works.total is the full count and the person page lists the rest. works.ordered_by is `recordings` when the list starts with the most-recorded works, and `coded` when it is in catalogue-code order: then it is a sample, not the writer's best-known songs.
name: get_songwriter
